runtime_amendment: 2016/17 development pilot only: unrestricted bagging took over two minutes per small fit. Before any 2018+ outer fits, bound bagged trees to 64 trees, depth 14 and 5 training seasons. Discard pilot fits; other families retain expanding histories and explicit 3/5-year ablations. No outer score used for this amendment.
purpose: Find useful improvements to expected FPL points, minutes and decisions; do not promote automatically.
forecast_grain: player-fixture, with predictions and outcomes summed to player-gameweek for primary points evaluation
headline_population: same lag-defined active pool for every model: mean minutes in last 3 observed fixtures >=45, or GW<=3 and previous-season minutes>=900

sources.annual: explicit-code previous-season totals only, no future-year aggregate
sources.understat: explicit FPL crosswalk only, matches on strictly earlier calendar days; provider-specific missingness and exposure
sources.team: 1993/94 onward match results, conservative completed-date cutoff; no bookmaker odds without proven deadline timestamps
sources.partial_sqlite: quarantined from main scores due to identity conflicts and selective missing outcomes; auxiliary sensitivity only if a safe common feature schema is possible

feature_cutoff: strictly smaller GW and kickoff+3h < earliest target GW kickoff-90m; Understat and date-only team results available next UTC day
historical_limitations: realised fixture assignments, no historic schedule/roster/news vintages
season position may come from an end-season snapshot
all old outcomes already inspected, so retrospective outer tests are not untouched external holdouts
zero is never substituted for unavailable provider statistics
known_rule_changes: Direct and hurdle models train points with realised DC awards removed from labels, then add a lag-only expected DC component at inference. This prevents asking a pre-2025 learner to invent the new scoring rule. No target DC is used in features.

search.budget: up to 100 declared configurations across at least 9 distinct families; no selecting hyperparameters on outer test outcomes
search.training: expanding seasons; declared recency and source ablations may use rolling 3/5-season windows
search.folds: inner OOF predictions start 2016/17; reported nested outer tests 2018/19 through 2025/26
search.selection: at each outer season select configurations and families using only the preceding 3 seasons of OOF active-pool MSE, equal weight per season
search.preprocessing: fit imputation/scaling on training subset only; fixed feature definitions; no random-row validation or early stopping on outer data
search.ensembles: nonnegative weights summing to one fitted on earlier chronological OOF predictions, with equal season weights; report a selected single model too
search.calibration: fit only on earlier OOF predictions; report raw and calibrated results
search.secondary_seeds: retrain finalist configurations for stability, never select the best seed

metrics: legal owned-squad lineup with actual autosubs
uncertainty: paired temporal block bootstrap of consecutive gameweeks, and season-level variation; current 7 weeks too few for precise intervals; all-model comparisons descriptive
six_gameweek: separate start-GW forecast of next six realised GW outcomes with all player features frozen at start cutoff; only complete future windows; purge labels crossing training/validation boundaries; retrospective schedule oracle caveat
current: seven pinned pre-deadline snapshots; no refitting on current outcomes; apply only captured availability flags; no invented past Claude overrides; conditional owned-squad test is not a transfer-policy backtest
promotion: research-only artifact; require useful consistency across recent seasons, minutes calibration and owned decisions, preserve sourced override interface, then prospective confirmation
